Subject Arrest of four Communists in Yulin Road District
on May 13 & 15, 1935.

Made by D.S. Sansom. Forwarded by [签名]

The case against the four communist suspects arrested
by the Municipal Police in connection with the chalking of
communist slogans on walls in the Yulin Road District on
May 13, was concluded in the Second Branch of the Kiangsu High
Court on May 28 when they were each sentenced to a term of
two years and six months imprisonment.

As a result of enquiries into this case, three communist
controlled schools in the Eastern District, with which the
arrested men were connected, have virtually ceased to exist.

The schools affected are, (1) Zung Zung Vocational
Middle School, 159/170 Tsu Ka Ba Road (3 teachers and about
20 pupils); (2) The Oriental Morning & Evening School, No. 477
Holung Road (3 teachers and 6 pupils), and (3) a school (unnamed)
in a tea shop at No. 516 Tsu Ka Ba Road (one teacher and about
4 pupils).

Information supplied to the Public Safety Bureau
led to the discovery of a communist controlled school in Chapel
and the arrest of two teachers concerned.

At 9.55 p.m. 13-5-35, C.P.C. 1464 brought the 1st. accused to the station and stated that he had arrested him at 9.45 p.m. even date, on Baikal Road near Lay Road. At the time of his arrest, the 1st accused was seen to throw away a piece of chalk which was recovered by the C.P.C.

The undersigned and C.D.C's 325 and 220 made enquiries and ascertained the following:-

C.P.C. 1464 was on duty on No. 3 Post, situated on Baikal Road near Lay Road, when at about 9.45 p.m. 13-5-35, the C.P.C. saw the 1st accused together with 3 other male Chinese chalking something on a nearby wall.

The C.P.C. investigated, and at his approached all 4 men ran away, but the C.P.C. managed to effect the arrest of the 1st accused. On looking at the wall upon which the men had been busily writing in white chalk, the C.P.C. discovered them to be communist slogans, so he therefore took the 1st accused into custody.

C.D.C. 220 was sent to copy the slogans written on the wall, they proved to be as follows:-

The 1st. & 4th accused have also made statements to this effect.

Inspector Dong Pei ( 董豹 ) of the P.S. Bureau, attended the station and was furnished with the names of several persons residing in Chinese Territory whom the accused denounced as being members of the Chinese Communist Party.

The 4th accused appeared before the Court on the morning of the 16-5-35, when he too, was remanded until the 21-5-35. In open court he made a full confession and also implicated the other accused.

A representative of the P.S. Bureau was in Court and made an application for all accused to be handed over to them. This was not granted, the presiding Judge ordering him to obtain a despatch warrant and present it in Court at the next hearing.

The 3rd accused has one previous conviction for communism in which he was sentenced to 1 year and 2 months imprisonment in the French Concession, but was found not guilty on appeal in 1933.

Made by D.S. Sansom. Forwarded by [Signature]

Further interrogation of the four accused in this
case has failed to elicit any additional useful information.
They will re-appear before the Court on May 21, 1935 when they
will be charged with Propagating Communism under Article 6 of the Law Governing the
Punishment of Persons who commit acts injurious to the
Republic of China.

The four men admit being members of the Social
Scientists' League, an auxiliary organ of the Communist Party,
working under the direction of one named Lee ( 李 ) who
has not been located by the Police.

The work of these men centred around the opening
about two months ago of the Oriental Morning & Evening
(Primary) School at No. 477 Holung Road for the specific
purpose of propagating Communism among students. Aside from
this, all four men have on one of two occasions, some of them
on both occasions, chalked slogans on walls in Yulin Road
District.

A list of addresses found among literature seized at
the Oriental Morning & Evening (Primary) School is supposed
to have been drafted 3 years ago by a teacher named Lieu Kwei
Yuan ( 刘桂元 ), who has left Shanghai. The list include
the 3rd accused in this case, under the alias of Tseu Fong Kwei
( 周芳奎 ). The arrested men disclaim any knowledge of
the others. Enquiries regarding the Settlement addresses
are in progress.

The Public Safety Bureau are investigating a number
of addresses in Chinese controlled territory of adherents of
the Social Scientists' League, given by the four accused.

我于中华民国八年（1919年）农历六月十八日出生于马来亚槟城。
我的父亲是浙江省杭州人。他和我的岳父都在槟城经营当铺。
中华民国二十一年（1932年），我前往广东。后来我来到上海，在雅信钢琴学校（德国）以及一位中国人的家中学习钢琴课。我希望成为一名音乐家，并且不相信共产主义。然而，由于我的大多数朋友都倾向于共产主义，我也被卷入其中。因此，我对共产党的各种运作体系以及党员通常穿着的服装等有着非常清楚的了解。的确，我过去并没有阻碍共产党，但将来我会向他们复仇。既往不咎；从今以后，我将在三民主义的指导下为国民党服务，并尽力破坏共产党，以弥补我过去的错误。这并非虚言。如果有机会，我将走上街头（因为我仍能认出一些共产党员），假装加入他们的党。然后我会揭发他们。
关于本案，我将提交一份新的完整报告。社会科学家联盟是共产党的辅助组织。我们与联盟的关系是通过第三指挥官王世兴 (Wang Shih Hing)，由第四指挥官曾子明 (Tseng Tse Ming) 建立的。我不

know the date when the person known as Li ( 李 ) (a member
of the Standing Committee of the League in question) had

they asked me to join them. Tsang Tse Ling in particular
persuaded me with attractive words. To speak the truth,
I hesitated all the time, because I had an idea that the

existing in my mind, namely, to join the Social Scientists'

Yee Tseng Soong ( 葉增松 ), 1st accused, is a member

with which to purchase a reactionary publication entitled
"Rise Up."
Under the guidance of the Kuomintang, I will
strongly oppose Communist activities in China. I have
voluntarily reported to the police an address of a Workers'

Yee Tseng Soong. The teaching at the school was undertaken

书记员 Chiang King Yon

去年八月，我居住在 Haig Li（海格里），并在那里为今年一所政治学校的入学考试做准备。当时，我偶然遇到一位名叫 Tsang Yung（張用）的同乡，他是 Chenju（音译）中国大学的学生，也是社会科学家联盟的成员。他向我提供了各种社会科学书籍，以及该联盟出版的一些小册子。

十月，我将家搬至光华大学后门处的一栋无门牌号的房屋，Tsang Yung 又给了我更多的书籍和小册子。

今年一月底，经一位朋友推荐，我成为诚成职业学校的英语教师。由于与校长意见不合，我于三月底离职，并自愿创办了东方日夜学校。自从我在诚成职业学校任教后，未再从该联盟收到任何书籍和小册子，因此我与共产党组织的联系就此断绝。

不料 Siao Tsang（第四被告）对我说：“我们没有前途。我们是年轻人，应该享受政治生活。你能不能设法建立一些联系？”
我便告诉他，我已数月未与共产党发生关系，但我可以写信给在中国大学的一位姓 Tsang（張）的同乡，他可能会为我们建立联系。结果，

In August, 1933 I was working as a Communist among workers of various cotton mills in the Eastern and Western Districts of Shanghai. Between September and October I was introduced to D.I. Kuh Pao Hwa by my friends So Wing Sung (沙銀生) and Li Hai Foong (李海峯 C.D.C.280) and was then employed as an informer with S. 2, Special Branch.

Later, I gave information concerning a Communist base in Hsin Hwa Li (新華里), Pingliang Road, and 3 Communists were arrested. The first, named Loo King San (罗金山), was sentenced to 5 years' imprisonment, and the other two to 2 years and a half imprisonment each. In this connection I was given by D.I. Kuh Pao Hwa a reward of $80 through the hands of the C.D.C. Li Hai Foong.

In December 1933 about 100 Communists gathered at the Tung Tai Dong Benevolent Institution on Pakhoi Road and demanded that rice be issued to them. I passed this information to C.D.C. Li Hai Foong who in turn transmitted it to D.I. Kuh Pao Hwa. The crowd was eventually dispersed by the police.

From that time up to the beginning of this year I haven't met any Communist. On April 7 or 8, 1935, I went to study at the Oriental Morning & Evening School, Nanking Road, and began to meet Wang Jih Ming (王傑明), Zhou Tu Ping (周土平), and Zhang Mao Ling (張毛麟). 1933年8月，我在上海东西区各棉纺厂的工人中进行共产主义工作。9月至10月间，经朋友 So Wing Sung（沙銀生）和 Li Hai Foong（李海峯，C.D.C.280）介绍，我结识了侦探长 Kuh Pao Hwa，随后受雇于特科二股（S. 2, Special Branch）担任线人。

后来，我提供了关于平凉路新华里一处共产党基地的情报，导致3名共产党员被捕。第一名名为 Loo King San（罗金山），被判处五年监禁，另外两人各被判两年半监禁。在此事中，侦探长 Kuh Pao Hwa 通过 C.D.C. 李海峯之手，给予我80元奖金。

1933年12月，约100名共产党员聚集在北四川路的东泰东慈善机构，要求发放米粮。我将此情报传递给 C.D.C. 李海峯，他随即转告侦探长 Kuh Pao Hwa。人群最终被警察驱散。

从那时起到今年年初，我未曾接触过任何共产党员。1935年4月7日或8日，我前往南京路的东方日夜学校求学，并开始结识 Wang Jih Ming（王傑明）、Zhou Tu Ping（周土平）和 Zhang Mao Ling（張毛麟）。在该校学习一段时间后，我发现他们都是共产党的同志。后来，我曾两次在墙上书写共产主义标语，但在第二次于雷士渡路附近的贝加尔路墙上书写时，被 C.P.C.1464 看见并逮捕。
自1933年12月以来，我不再担任警方线人。

Tsang Tse Ling (張志麟),
Shanghai    xx    D.S. Serves.
Yulin Rd. Stn.    15.5.35.    Clerk Chiang King Yong

My name is Tsang Tse Ling (張志麟), age 21, native
of Shanghai, residing with my mother Tsang Tseu Sz (張周氏)
at an un-numbered house adjoining No. 477 Holing Road.
I was educated at the Tung Wei (同惠) Primary
School, French Concession, and at the Yangtsepoo Social
Centre, No. 84 Yangtsepoo Road, where I studied for 6 and 2
years respectively. I left the latter school at the age of
17, and joined the Communist Party through the introduction
of a male named Wee (吳). I haven't seen him for the past
2 years. The Communist Party through a member named Wong
arranged for me to take over the latter's post as principal
in the Ming Sung (民生) Primary School located in the
Dsung Zung Li (順成里), Tsu Ka Ba Road, near Langshan Road.
There were about 30 pupils in the school of ages ranging
between 10 and 20. Two other teachers named Kan Yu Ming
(甘雨民) and Zoe (徐), a female, assisted me. This
school had been established by the Communist Party for 6 months
before I obtained my appointment. Pupil fees were sixty
cents per month. Our object was to spread communist
propaganda among the pupils whilst giving other lessons. I
received no pay from the Party and had to subsist on the fees
received from pupils. The school closed down after I had
been employed there for 3 months, because Yangtsepoo Police
Station had been informed of our activities. The police
raided the school (in 1933) and succeeding in arresting
in-arresting Kan Yu Ming aforementioned. The female teacher
and myself absconded.

我叫张志麟，21岁，上海籍，与母亲张周氏 (Tsang Tseu Sz) 居住在霍林路 (Holing Road) 477号旁一间无门牌号的房屋内。
我曾就读于法租界同惠 (Tung Wei) 小学，以及杨树浦路84号杨树浦社会中心，分别学习了6年和2年。我17岁时离开后者，经由一名姓吴 (Wee) 的男子介绍加入共产党。过去两年我未再见过他。共产党通过一名姓王 (Wong) 的成员安排我接替其在民生 (Ming Sung) 小学的校长职务，该校位于郎山路附近的朱家巴路 (Tsu Ka Ba Road) 顺成里 (Dsung Zung Li)。校内约有30名学生，年龄在10至20岁之间。另有两名教师甘雨民 (Kan Yu Ming) 和一名姓徐 (Zoe) 的女士协助我。这所学校在我任职前已由共产党建立了6个月。学生学费为每月六角。我们的目标是在授课的同时向学生传播共产主义宣传。我从党那里没有领取薪水，靠收取的学生学费维持生计。在我受雇3个月后，学校关闭，因为杨树浦巡捕房获悉了我们的活动。警察突袭了学校（在1933年），并成功逮捕了上述甘雨民。女教师和我逃走了。

pages.en:
- 2 -

In 1933 I severed my connections with the Communist
Party and obtained a job as mess-cook on an American warship
named "Smith-Thomson" (destroyer No. 212). I left this job
after 4 months service and became unemployed for 6 months,
being supported by my mother who derives money from land
owned by her.

In 1934, from March to May, I was employed as a mess-
cook on American destroyer No. 222. From May till January
of this year I was again unemployed.

With the knowledge of English acquired aboard
American warships I then (January, 1935) became a teacher of
English at the Tsung Yung Vocational Middle School (認誠職業學校)
located in the Tsung Yung Li, Tzu Ka Ba Road. I obtained
the post on my own initiative. Through lack of school funds
I had to resign in February.

Two other teachers were forced to resign with me,
namely Wong Jih Ming (王保明) and Tseu Tsan Ming (周士平),
(the 2nd, 3rd accused in this case). Together, we established
the Oriental Morning & Evening School, located at No. 477
Helung Road, during February, 1935. The school was opened
without any communist influence as far as I am aware, and was
financed by the 3rd accused to the extent of $60. This
individual stated that he had obtained $300 from his wife,
which money she had remitted to her from her parents at Penang.
Two weeks after the school had been established the 2nd
accused instructed me to continue communist activities. A
few days later he brought along a male named Lee (李).
pages.zh:

1933年，我与共产党断绝联系，并在名为“Smith-Thomson”（第212号驱逐舰）的美国军舰上担任伙食厨师。服务4个月后我离职，失业6个月，期间由依靠自有土地收入生活的母亲供养。

1934年3月至5月，我在美国第222号驱逐舰上担任伙食厨师。从5月到今年1月，我再次失业。

凭借在美国军舰上获得的英语知识，我于当时（1935年1月）成为位于朱家巴路宗庸里 (Tsung Yung Li) 的认诚职业学校 (Tsung Yung Vocational Middle School) 的英语教师。我是主动获得该职位的。由于缺乏学校资金，我不得不于2月辞职。

另外两名教师被迫与我一同辞职，即王保明 (Wong Jih Ming) 和周士平 (Tseu Tsan Ming)（本案的第二、第三被告）。我们一起于1935年2月在霍伦路 (Helung Road) 477号创办了东方早晚学校。据我所知，学校的开办没有任何共产主义影响，并由第三被告出资60美元资助。此人声称他从妻子那里获得了300美元，这笔钱是她父母从槟城汇给她的。学校成立两周后，第二被告指示我继续开展共产主义活动。几天后，他带来了一名姓李 (Lee) 的男子。

1935年5月13日晚9时45分，华籍巡捕1464号在贝加尔路执勤时，看见第一被告与其他三人在墙上书写标语。当第一被告被捕时，他将一块粉笔（疑似）扔在地上，其他三人逃跑。在巡捕房，华籍侦探警员220号和365号进行了询问，发现标语写在九个不同的地方，如‘打倒国民党’‘出来抗议苏维埃’等。当讯问第一被告时，他表示自己、萧张 (Siau Tsang) 和马 (Mah) 一起在贝加尔路上行走，他带领侦探前往霍伦路477号（东方早晚学校），第二和第三被告在那里被捕。进行了搜查，查获大量共产主义书籍，有几本书被扔出窗外（呈堂证物），还发现了一台复印机。华籍巡捕1464号指认第二被告是书写标语的人之一，因此我请求将所有三名被告拘留以作进一步调查。

华籍巡捕1464号 :- 1935年5月13日晚9时45分，我在贝加尔路和雷路拐角处执勤，我看见第一和第二被告在墙上书写标语，于是我逮捕了第一被告，随后他将一块粉笔扔在地上，其他人逃跑了，他们在墙上写了六七条标语。

Yee Tseng Soong.
Anhwei                                      D.S. Jones.
Y.R.Station             14-5-35.

My name is Yee Tseng Soong (奚正松) alias Lau Hoo
(老胡) age 26, native of Anhwei. My father was a farmer;
he died six years ago, while my mother is living at Weiweilei
(無為縣), Luiscufu (廬州府), Anhwei. From the age of 7 to
9 years, I attended a primary school at Wuzeilee, On leaving
school, until I was 18, I helped my father on his farm.
Harvests were poor and so I came to Shanghai in search of
work. For two years I worked at the Sung Sing Cotton Mill,
Yangtsepoo. This mill closed down and I then went to the
Doong Shing (同興) Cotton Mill at Linching Road. I
remained at this mill until about a year ago and then
resigned owing to eye trouble and earned my living as a
hawker selling peanuts and turnips. I am still living at the
Doong Shing Mill.

One week ago I began to attend the Oriental Morning
and Evening School (東方夜學坊), No. 477 Holung Road to study
elementary Chinese characters. I first knew of the school
when I saw an advertising posted outside the school. Fees
are only 20 cents a month.

At 6 p.m. on the 13th I left the school in company
with a student named Ma (馬) and Wong (王) (2nd
accused). When we reached Baikal Road and Lay Road corner
Wong and Ma began to write on the wall. They told me to keep
a look-out, which I did. a policeman appeared. Wong and Ma
ran off and I was arrested.

I am not a communist and I do not belong to any
political party.

叶正松。
安徽                                      侦探警佐 Jones。
杨树浦警察局             1935年5月14日。

我叫叶正松 (奚正松)，别名老胡
(老胡)，26岁，安徽籍。我的父亲是农民；
他六年前去世，而我母亲居住在安徽庐州府无为县。
从7岁到9岁，我在吴泽里的一所小学读书。离开
学校后，直到18岁，我一直在父亲的农场帮忙。
收成不好，所以我来到上海寻找工作。我在杨树浦的
松兴棉纱厂工作了两年。该厂倒闭后，我去了临清路的
同兴 (Doong Shing) 棉纱厂。我
在这家工厂一直工作到大约一年前，后因眼疾辞职，靠卖花生和萝卜的小贩生意谋生。我仍住在
同兴纱厂。

一周前，我开始去霍龙路477号的东方早晚学校（東方夜學坊）学习基础汉字。我第一次知道这所学校是因为看到学校外面张贴的广告。学费每月仅20分。

13日下午6时，我与一名姓马 (馬) 的学生和王 (王)（第二被告）一起离开学校。当我们到达贝加尔路和莱路拐角处时，王和马开始在墙上写字。他们让我放哨，我便照做了。一名警察出现。王和马逃跑了，我被捕。

我不是共产党人，也不属于任何政党。

Wong Jih-ming ( 王志明 )
Shingning ( 新寧 )                                D. S. Jones
Yulin Rd Station        14/5/35                  Clerk Loh Wai-kong

My name is Wong Jih-ming, age 23 years, I was
born at Shingning ( 新寧 ), Kwangtung My parents are
still alive and run a clothing and toy shop in this town
At the age of six years, I began to attend the Shingning
Middle School and studied there until May, 1934, when I
graduated. I then went to Nanking and would have joined
the Central Political University in that city, but I failed
to pass the entrance examination in July. On August 4,
I came to Shanghai. The following day I sat for the
entrance examination to enable me to enter the Tsing Hwa
( 清華大學 ) University at Peiping, but I failed again.
From August to October, 1934 I lived in Avenue Haig
(number forgotten). After this I lived at No.67 Great
Western Road (Chinese Territory) until the end of December.
I receive approximately $200 a year from my father as
living expenses.

Since January of this year I have been employed
as a teacher of English at the Zung Zung Commercial
School ( 誠成中學 ), Chow Ka Ba Road. I am now residing
at No.477 Molung Road.

I am not a communist, neither do I belong to any
political party.

At about 9 p.m. on May 13 I was walking with a
pupil named Lau Hoo ( 老胡 ) (Yee Tseng-soeng 吳正松 ),
to whom I have given lessons at my home. Although I am
his teacher I do not know his full name. I was walking
in front of Lau Hoo and did not know he had been arrested

王志明 (Wong Jih-ming)
新寧 (Shingning)                                D. S. Jones
榆林路巡捕房        1935年5月14日                  书记员 罗伟公 (Loh Wai-kong)

本人名叫王志明，现年23岁，出生于广东新寧。父母健在，在该镇经营一家服装及玩具店。
六岁时，我开始就读于新寧中学，并在那里学习至1934年5月毕业。随后我前往南京，本欲报考该市的中央政治大学，但未能通过七月份的入学考试。8月4日，我来到上海。次日，我参加了北平清华大学 (Tsing Hwa University) 的入学考试，但再次落榜。1934年8月至10月期间，我居住在海格路（门牌号已遗忘）。此后，我居住在华界大西路67号，直至12月底。父亲每年寄给我约200元作为生活费。

自今年一月起，我在周家嘴路诚成中学 (Zung Zung Commercial School) 担任英语教师。目前我居住在莫伦路477号。

我不是共产党员，也不属于任何政党。

5月13日晚9时许，我与一名叫老胡 (Lau Hoo)（即吴正松 Yee Tseng-soeng）的学生同行，我曾在家中给他补课。虽然我是他的老师，但我并不知道他的全名。我走在老胡前面，并不知道他因书写共产主义标语而被捕

pages.en:

for writing communist slogans. I was back home at
roughly 9.45 p.m. A few minutes later the Police
called and arrested me. The pro-communist books found
at my home were for purposes of study.

(Signed) Wong Jih-ming.

。我大约在晚上9点45分回到家中。几分钟后，警察上门将我逮捕。在我家中发现的亲共书籍是用于学习目的。

Tseu Tsz-bing (周士平)
Hangchow                                      S.S.I. Prokofiev
Yulin Rd Station        14/5/35               Clerk Loh Wei-kong

My name is Tseu Tsz-bing, age 16, native of
Hangchow, married, student of music, residing at No.477
Holung road. I was born at Penang where my father
conducts a pawnshop. From age of six, I attended school
at Penang for about nine years, after which I went to
Shanghai, arriving here in April, 1934. In Shanghai
I have been studying music at the Zung Yien (陈蕴)
Piano School, No.45 Yuen Chong Li, Route Vallon, and
since recently also at the Yaocbi School for Music,
situated at Route des Soeurs. While in Shanghai
I resided at various addresses until March, 1935 when I
removed to No.477 Holung Road. At this address, there
is a school named Oriental Morning & Evening School
(東方晨夜校). I am occupying a room in that house
together with my wife and my friend named Wong Jih-ming
(王傑明), the 2nd accused whom I met in Shanghai
about two months ago. Wong and another man named Tsang
(蒋), whose address I do not know, are the proprietors
of the school. Yee Tseng-soeng (葉正松), the 1st
accused, used to call on Wong two or three times a week.
I never talk to him and I therefore do not know where he
lives and what his business is. At about 9 p.m. on
May 13, Wong went out and returned at about half past
ten. At this time I was already in bed. Soon afterwards
the Police arrived and arrested Wong and I myself. At
the time the Police arrived I was already asleep and
therefore did not see who threw the books out of the

周士平 (Tseu Tsz-bing)
杭州                                        高级副督察 Prokofiev
榆林路巡捕房        1935年5月14日               书记员 罗伟公 (Loh Wei-kong)

本人名叫周士平，现年16岁，籍贯杭州，已婚，音乐专业学生，居住在霍伦路477号。我出生于槟城，父亲在那里经营一家当铺。从六岁起，我在槟城上学约九年，之后前往上海，于1934年4月抵达。在上海，我一直在法租界亚尔培路 (Route Vallon) 源忠里45号的陈蕴 (Zung Yien) 钢琴学校学习音乐，最近也开始在位于姐妹路 (Route des Soeurs) 的 Yaocbi 音乐学校学习。在上海期间，我辗转居住于多处地址，直到1935年3月搬至霍伦路477号。该地址有一所名为东方晨夜校的学校。我与妻子以及我的朋友王傑明 (Wong Jih-ming)（第二被告，我约两个月前在上海结识）共同居住在该房屋的一个房间内。王某和另一名姓蒋 (Tsang) 的男子（其住址我不清楚）是该学校的业主。第一被告叶正松 (Yee Tseng-soeng) 过去每周拜访王某两三次。我从未与他交谈，因此不知道他住在哪里以及从事什么职业。5月13日晚9时许，王某外出，约十点半返回。当时我已经上床睡觉。不久后警察到达，逮捕了王某和我本人。警察到达时我已经睡着，因此没有看到是谁把书扔出

pages.en:

window. All books and the duplicator found in our room
belong to Wong. I am not a communist, and know nothing
about communism. I am living on the money which
my father regularly remits to me.

(Signed) Tseu Tsz-bing.

（签名）周士平。
